svg.title: Release checks
svg.desc: Check: Full final-binary regression, Observed result: 418 tests, one expected skip; 17 smoke checks; exit 0 in 772 s, Retained proof: Exact log, binary/source/test hashes; Check: Independent static review, Observed result: One P2 found and fixed; no other confirmed P1/P2. Malformed frame selection now fails before mutation; explicit empty selection remains valid, Retained proof: Before/after and review scope; Check: Visible GUI, Observed result: Three additional real-window tests passed: Accounts launch, scripted sign-in completion and handoff hiding, Retained proof: GUI log; Check: Live usability, Observed result: HTTPS page loaded with 200, snapshot/screenshot worked, trusted fill/click completed a local form; native Accounts window rendered and closing it left daemon usable, Retained proof: Receipt and inspected screenshots; Check: Inspector, Observed result: Desktop 1280×900 and mobile 390×844 loaded without overflow/errors; unauthenticated state rejected with 403, preview off by default, requested capture worked, Retained proof: Final-build usability receipt; Check: Concurrent operation, Observed result: All 1/4/8/16/32-client semantic levels passed, with leases, wrong-owner rejection, three progress rounds, queued/running cancellation, drain and connection bounds, Retained proof: Final-binary grid; Check: Observation reconstruction, Observed result: All 16 states reconstruct exact text, ordered refs and six metadata fields independently over all three transports, Retained proof: Every actual response and reconstruction; Check: Documentation/artwork, Observed result: 24 accessible SVGs parse, cool palette checked, all 16 generated figures match sources and recorded data, Retained proof: python3 assets/validate.py; closeout receipt
